(c) Answer any five questions.
(e) Map stencils are allowed.
1. Give various sources of Population data with special reference to Indian Census.
2. Explain in detail the factors affecting distribution of population.
3. What is Mortality ? Discuss the determinants of population growth.
4. Discuss Demographic Transition Theory and its relevance to the current world.
5. Give a detailed outline of the world population growth scenario.
7. Discuss the Indian Population Policy and its significance.
8. Discuss the dynamics of population pyramids by citing examples from developed and developing regions.
9. Write short notes on any two of the following.
(i) Ageing population
(ii) Malthusian Theory
(iii) Nature of population Geography
